case.name: Singer Query
case.description: Leviathan asks a singer at the table how a person could know if they're good at it. No reason. Just curious. Probably.

notes.note: Don't worry about giving an answer that "won't result in death." As long as the answer isn't "I refuse to answer" or "I eat babies" or any derivatives thereof, this will resolve peacefully.
